To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a battery powered switched-reuctance motor drive is proposed.

1) a front-end converter for SRM drive is developed to achieve good line power conditioning performance and robust speed control capability; 2) the converter is operated in boost and buck modes to provide dynamically boostable and regulated dc-link voltage for the SRM drive; 3) the robust speed control is achieved by a combination of disturbance feedforward and variable-structure control; 4) the regenerative braking capability is developed for SRM; and 5) the proposed converter is operated
the proposed front-end boost converter is capable of providing a well-regulated dc link voltage and a robust speed control for the battery powered SRM drive.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a battery powered SRM drive with the front-end converter and control schemes.
the development of a battery powered SRM drive system with the front-end converter, its control and regenerative braking control schemes.
the design of a front-end power converter and its digital control for the battery powered SRM drives.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the developed front-end converter and control schemes are suitable for battery powered SRM drives.
the proposed front-end boost converter and its control are suitable for battery powered switched reluctance motor drive applications.
a front-end dc-dc boost type converter is developed to effectively boost up the battery voltage and to provide a well-regulated dc link voltage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a front-end converter with its control for a high-performance battery powered SRM drive is presented.
the proposed front-end dc-dc converter can provide the necessary dc-link voltage and charging power for the battery powered SRM drive.
a front-end converter is developed and integrated with a battery powered SRM drive for the purpose of achieving a high dynamic performance and high efficiency.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed front-end power converter and control schemes can be effectively applied to the SRM drive system for electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid EVs.
the front-end converter can be operated as a boost-type converter or buck-type converter to achieve the desired battery charging or motoring performance.
the SRM drive system can be operated with good dynamic and steady-state performance by the proposed front-end dc-dc converter and its control.
